body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Jerez de la Frontera, Spain. It starts at Domecq Palace, Plaza Aladro, 2, Jerez de la Frontera, Spain. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Palacio Domecq Entrance Ticket.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Visiting the Domecq Palace is a unique experience in the city, as there is no other palace with the characteristics of this Andalusian Baroque jewel. Within its walls, you will not only find the beauty of exceptional architecture, but you will also experience the tradition and know-how of a family that left its mark on the city of Jerez and the world.
>
> Visits will be done in groups, starting every 60 min. Each entry will be assigned a visiting hour. Once the visit begins, you will not be able to access the Palace. It is essential to arrive 10 minutes in advance. The ticket includes a group visit to the Domecq Palace, touring the rooms of the Palace. It is a visit with an audio guide. Audio guide included, available in Spanish, English, and French. The visit lasts approximately 45 minutes. The entrance to the visit will be at Plaza Aladro nº 2.
